messages:
sophia: Quick async check-in re: Q3 enterprise trial (ACME Labs) — compiling escalations before EOD. I did: triaged support ticket #4521, pushed a temp routing rule to avoid 504s. blocker: persistent mismatch on latency vs prod baseline, customers seeing timeouts on long chats. today: coordinating with eng to test batch settings & fallback model. cc @raj @kevin

raj: Thanks. I ran a perf sweep on the dedicated pool last night. Found high variance at >1024 context. suspect KV cache thrashing. I can try enforced caching policy and smaller batch_size. pinging @maria for product constraints (SLA vs cost).

maria: Noted. Renewal week in 10 days, CRO wants confident numbers on latency SLO. Can we get a guarded fallback policy that switches to 1) quantized model variant or 2) regional fallback? Which one has less impact on token quality?

kevin: Quantized variant reduces mem but may degrade quality a bit. Regional fallback keeps model identical but adds network latency. For ACME's use case (short summaries + code snippets) I'd prefer quantized + eval against our prompt set. I'll assemble eval by noon.

sophia: Action: raj to test cache policy + smaller batch on staging; kevin to run eval between base and q8 variants; I'll draft a one-pager for CRO with fallback options and estimated token cost delta. ETA tomorrow 11am PT. Is that ok?

raj: ok. Quick FYI — reproduction steps in staging: run load script `./tools/load_test.sh --model rwd-base-1 --concurrency 40 --seq 1200`. Also turned on verbose logs: /logs/staging/4521.log. Saw repeated "KVLookupMiss" spikes.

kevin: I'll run eval. One more: can we set a canary rollout for q8 to 5% traffic only? need a config PR for rollout policy.

maria: Yes, canary is fine. Support ask: please add a line in the renewal deck calling out the fallback (we'll show cost delta + sample outputs). I'll draft wording, need sample outputs by EOD tomorrow.

sophia: thanks. small blocker: legal needs a note about data routing (regional fallback touches non-prod region). I'll open ticket with security.

raj: created ticket INFRA-987 and linked the staging logs. tagging infra team.

deploy-bot: Deployment started for canary config PR #2289 on staging.

kevin: PR #2289 is up for review: https://git.redwood/inference/pulls/2289 — @raj can you review perf changes? focus on batching defaults.

raj: review done, left two comments re: batch_size and cache TTL. will approve after quick tweak.

sophia: Perfect. I'll consolidate notes and ping CRO + renewal thread. :thumbsup:
